overview_description.description: AIOS Automotive Integrated Overhead Systems GmbH offers design and manufacturing of headliners and overhead systems for vehicles, covering the process from concept development through to serial production. The company provides headliner solutions designed for comfort, design integration, and technical functionality — using mouldable carrier systems, lightweight but stiff materials, and options like integrated air-conditioning ducts. Their services include R&D, prototype production (including GRP laminates and 3D-printed parts), tooling and series production, as well as comprehensive quality assurance and testing procedures to meet automotive standards. The company handles supplier management and process monitoring centrally via a Global Supplier Quality Standards manual, ensuring consistency across suppliers and internal manufacturing locations.
